questions.audio_url: https://ahorrativa.es/audios/BCT11/Q1.St Helena part of the UK.m4a
questions.question: Is St Helena part of the UK?
questions.explanation: British overseas territories, such as St Helena and the Falkland Islands are linked to the UK but are not part of it.
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 2: What is the UK?

learning.why_correct_en: St Helena and the Falkland Islands are British Overseas Territories: the UK is responsible for their sovereignty, but constitutionally they are not part of the UK. Eligible local residents are normally British Overseas Territories citizens (BOTCs) and may apply for the corresponding British passport. Since 21 May 2002, most BOTCs connected with these qualifying territories have also been British citizens; Falkland Islanders additionally benefited from the British Nationality (Falkland Islands) Act 1983. Many residents can therefore obtain a standard British citizen passport and may also hold a BOTC passport. BOTC status alone does not automatically give a right to live and work in the UK. Birth in a territory is not always sufficient by itself: the date of birth and a parent's citizenship or settled status also matter.
learning.why_correct_zh:
St Helena和Falkland Islands是British Overseas Territories：英国对其承担主权责任，但它们在宪法上不属于UK。当地符合条件的居民通常拥有British Overseas Territories citizenship（BOTC），可申请相应的英国护照。

自2002年5月21日起，与这些合资格领土有联系的大多数BOTC也取得British citizenship；Falkland Islanders还受到1983年专门法案保障。因此不少居民可申请普通British citizen passport，也可以同时持有BOTC护照。只有BOTC而没有British citizenship的人，并不自动享有在英国本土定居和工作的权利。出生在当地也不是无条件取得身份，仍取决于出生时间及父母当时的国籍或定居身份。
learning.source_note_zh: 官方教材是答案和考试范围的主要依据；其他权威来源用于补充该主题背景。

learning.why_correct_en: Margaret Thatcher was the first woman Prime Minister of the UK.
learning.why_correct_zh:
玛格丽特·撒切尔最著名的历史身份是：她于1979年成为英国第一位女首相。她任职至1990年11月，并连续赢得三次大选。

“Iron Lady”有明确的起点。1976年1月19日，仍是反对党领袖的撒切尔发表“Britain Awake”演讲，警告苏联扩张和军力增长，主张英国及西方加强防务。

1月24日，苏联军方报纸Red Star称她为“Iron Lady”。这个称呼原本是冷战宣传中的负面标签，把她描绘成不妥协、反苏和好战的西方政客。

她没有回避，而是主动重新定义。1月31日，她在Finchley的演讲中幽默地称自己是“西方世界的Iron Lady”，并把“强硬”解释为捍卫西方价值、自由和国防决心。
learning.answer_summary_zh: 正确选项：She was the first woman Prime Minister of the UK。

questions.audio_url: https://ahorrativa.es/audios/BCT11/Q10.radio and television coverage of the political parties must be balanced.m4a
questions.question: By law, radio and television coverage of the political parties must be balanced and so equal time has to be given to rival viewpoints.
questions.explanation: This statement is true.
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 5: The UK government, the law and your role

learning.why_correct_en: UK broadcasters must observe due impartiality when covering political controversy and elections. This requires appropriate weight for significant rival viewpoints; it does not necessarily mean mechanically identical minutes for every party in every programme.
learning.why_correct_zh:
题库把本题判为True，是因为Television和Radio确实受到法定广播公正性规则约束。《Communications Act 2003》第319和320条要求Ofcom制定due impartiality（适当公正性）标准，并由《Broadcasting Code》落实。

但“equal time”不是现行法律的准确标准。Ofcom明确说明，due impartiality不要求给每个观点完全相同的播出时间。选举期间，应根据政党和独立候选人过去及当前的支持度给予due weight（适当权重），并考虑具有重要意义的观点。因此，报道时长可以不同，只要整体没有不公正地偏向一方。
learning.source_note_zh: 官方教材是答案和考试范围的主要依据；其他权威来源用于补充该主题背景。

questions.audio_url: https://ahorrativa.es/audios/BCT11/Q17.make a complaint about the police.m4a
questions.question: What should you do to make a complaint about the police (choose two answers)?
questions.explanation: Anyone can make a complaint about the police by going to a police station and writing to the Chief Constable of the police force involved. Complaints can also be made to an independent body: the Independent Police Complaints Commission in England and Wales, the Police Complaints Commissioner for Scotland or the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland.
correct_answers: Go to the Police station directly
Write to the Chief Constable of the police force involved
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 5: The UK government, the law and your role

learning.why_correct_en: Anyone can make a complaint about the police by going to a police station and writing to the Chief Constable of the police force involved. Complaints can also be made to an independent body: the Independent Police Complaints Commission in England and Wales, the Police Complaints Commissioner for Scotland or the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland.
learning.why_correct_zh:
本题的两个答案是直接前往警察局，或写信给涉事警队的Chief Constable。Chief Constable是地方警队的最高级警官；投诉实际通常由警队的Professional Standards Department（专业标准部门）处理，并非由Chief Constable本人逐一处理。

以英格兰和威尔士为例，现在也可以通过警队网站、101电话或IOPC表格投诉。IOPC一般会把投诉转给相关警队，由警队评估并记录；最严重的案件必须转交IOPC。处理结果通知会说明能否申请review（复核），通常须在28天内提出。
learning.answer_summary_zh: 正确选项：Go to the Police station directly；Write to the Chief Constable of the police force involved。
learning.source_note_zh: 官方教材是答案和考试范围的主要依据；其他权威来源用于补充该主题背景。

questions.explanation: William Wordsworth wrote ‘The Daffodils’.
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 4: A modern, thriving society

learning.why_correct_en: William Wordsworth wrote ‘The Daffodils’.
learning.why_correct_zh:
正确的花是 daffodil（水仙花）。William Wordsworth 的这首诗通常被称为《Daffodils》，正式标题是《I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud》。其中最著名的几句是：

“I wandered lonely as a cloud ...
A host, of golden daffodils;
And then my heart with pleasure fills,
And dances with the daffodils.”

大意是：我独自漫游如一朵云……眼前是一大片金黄水仙；后来回忆起这幅景象，心便充满快乐，也随水仙起舞。
learning.source_note_zh: 官方教材是答案和考试范围的主要依据；其他权威来源用于补充该主题背景。

questions.explanation: Emmeline Pankhurst was born in Manchester in 1858. She set up the women’s Franchise League in 1889, which fought to get the vote in local elections for married women. In 1903 she helped found the Women’s Social and Political Union (WSPU). This was the first group whose members were called ‘suffragettes’.

learning.why_correct_zh: 艾米琳·潘克赫斯特 (Emmeline Pankhurst) 1858 年出生于曼彻斯特。她于 1889 年成立了妇女特许经营联盟，为已婚妇女在地方选举中争取投票权而奋斗。 1903 年，她帮助成立了妇女社会和政治联盟 (WSPU)。这是第一个其成员被称为“妇女参政论者”的团体。
